name: Acolyte
description: You spent your life in service to a temple, mediating between the divine and the mortal.

feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
feature.description: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith, and you can call on the support of fellow believers.

name: Charlatan
description: You have a way with people and a talent for telling them what they want to hear.

feature.name: False Identity
feature.description: You have a second persona with documents and contacts, and you can forge believable papers.

name: Criminal
description: You are an experienced lawbreaker with ties to a criminal underworld.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You have a reliable contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals.

name: Entertainer
description: You thrive in front of an audience, knowing how to entrance and inspire them.

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.description: You can always find a place to perform for food and lodging, and locals tend to recognize and favor you.

name: Folk Hero
description: You come from humble origins but are destined for much more — the common folk see you as their champion.

feature.name: Rustic Hospitality
feature.description: Common folk will shelter and hide you (short of risking their lives), since you're one of them.

name: Guild Artisan
description: You are a member of an artisan's guild, skilled in a particular craft and tied to other crafters.

feature.name: Guild Membership
feature.description: Your guild offers lodging, support, and connections in exchange for dues; fellow guild members will assist you.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion, seeking enlightenment, isolation, or a hidden truth.

feature.name: Discovery
feature.description: Your seclusion gave you a unique and powerful insight — a great secret about the cosmos, a person, or an organization.

name: Noble
description: You were born into wealth, power, and privilege, and people treat you accordingly.

feature.name: Position of Privilege
feature.description: People assume you have the right to be wherever you are; you're welcomed in high society and can secure audiences with the powerful.

name: Outlander
description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and its comforts.

feature.name: Wanderer
feature.description: You have an excellent memory for terrain and can always find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five others in the wild.

name: Sage
description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse, poring over books and scrolls.

feature.name: Researcher
feature.description: When you don't know something, you often know where and from whom you can learn it.

name: Sailor
description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years, weathering storms and brushes with sea monsters.

feature.name: Ship's Passage
feature.description: You can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your companions, working off the cost as crew.

name: Soldier
description: War has been your life — you trained, fought, and bled as part of an army.

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: Soldiers loyal to your former organization still recognize your authority; you can invoke your rank for access and influence.

name: Urchin
description: You grew up on the streets, alone and orphaned, learning to survive by your wits.

feature.name: City Secrets
feature.description: You know the secret patterns and flow of cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl twice as fast as others.
